name: Wakatsuki Ayame
source:
Class: 3-B
Favorite food: Green tea, takoyaki
Hobbies: Tea ceremonies (no matter where or when), [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ogura_Hyakunin_Isshu]Hyakunin Isshu[/url]
Troubles: Keeps getting turned and very wet all of a sudden just before going to bed.

One of [url=/c78241]Yuuya[/url]'s childhood friends. A third-year student who always dances to her own tune and keeps sipping tea at every possible moment; due to this she is known as a bit of a troublemaker. Due to her traditional personality, she is bad with all kinds of machines and anything high-tech, and also bad at both English (because she dislikes horizontal letters and alphabets) and Chemistry.

She is best friends with [url=/c8481]Nonomi[/url].
